description: Philosophy of science decomposed. Duhem-Quine thesis, underdetermination, inference to best explanation, no miracles argument, pessimistic meta-induction, structural realism, scientific values, replicability crisis, scientific revolutions in detail.

sub_mechanisms.name: Duhem_Quine_thesis
sub_mechanisms.definition: Theories tested in bundles, not individually. Falsification ambiguous about which hypothesis fails.
sub_mechanisms.why: Counters naive Popper. Any auxiliary assumption can be revised. 'Anywhere I please' (Quine). Foundation of underdetermination.

sub_mechanisms.name: underdetermination
sub_mechanisms.definition: Multiple theories consistent with all evidence. Choice underdetermined by data.
sub_mechanisms.why: Quine + others. Empirical equivalence + theoretical difference. Challenge to realism: which theory describes reality?

sub_mechanisms.name: inference_to_best_explanation
sub_mechanisms.definition: Accept hypothesis that best explains data. Common scientific reasoning.
sub_mechanisms.why: Lipton, Harman. Beyond enumerative induction. Cost: what makes explanation 'best'?

sub_mechanisms.name: no_miracles_argument
sub_mechanisms.definition: Realism best explains scientific success. Otherwise success would be miraculous.
sub_mechanisms.why: Putnam. Classic argument for scientific realism. Cost: success doesn't guarantee truth (pessimistic meta-induction).

sub_mechanisms.name: pessimistic_meta_induction
sub_mechanisms.definition: Past successful theories turned out false. By induction, current ones too.
sub_mechanisms.why: Laudan. Counter-argument to realism. Phlogiston, caloric, ether all 'successful' but false. Drives structural realism.

sub_mechanisms.name: structural_realism
sub_mechanisms.definition: Theories preserved structurally across change. Realism about structure, not ontology.
sub_mechanisms.why: Worrall. Compromise: realism about math structure of theories. ESR (epistemic) vs OSR (ontic). Contemporary realism.

sub_mechanisms.name: scientific_values
sub_mechanisms.definition: Values shape science: choice of problems, methods, evidence weights.
sub_mechanisms.why: Longino, Douglas. Beyond value-free ideal. Inductive risk: scientists make value-laden choices about evidence.

sub_mechanisms.name: replicability_crisis
sub_mechanisms.definition: Many published results fail replication. Psychology, biology, medicine.
sub_mechanisms.why: Modern problem. p-hacking, publication bias, statistical issues. Foundation crisis. Reforms: pre-registration, larger samples.

sub_mechanisms.name: incommensurability
sub_mechanisms.definition: Kuhn: paradigms use different concepts; can't be directly compared.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation of relativism in science. Newton's mass ≠ Einstein's mass. Costs: communication, rational comparison.

sub_mechanisms.name: scientific_method_pluralism
sub_mechanisms.definition: No single scientific method. Different sciences different methods.
sub_mechanisms.why: Feyerabend, modern. Biology vs physics vs psychology different methods. Cardinal sin: methodological monism.

sub_mechanisms.name: natural_kinds
sub_mechanisms.definition: Categories that 'carve nature at the joints'. Gold, water, electron.
sub_mechanisms.why: Kripke, Putnam. Foundation of essentialism. Cost: which kinds natural? Convention vs discovery debate.

sub_mechanisms.name: models_in_science
sub_mechanisms.definition: Models as representations: scale, ideal, computational. Not reducible to theories.
sub_mechanisms.why: Modern philosophy of science. Cartwright: laws lie; models work. Foundation: science via modelling.

derivation_rules.name: Duhem_Quine_blocks_naive_falsification
then: target theory may be saved by revising auxiliaries
derivation_rules.why: Falsification never unique. Saves theories from premature rejection but allows ad hoc rescue. Lakatos's progressive vs degenerating addresses.

derivation_rules.name: IBE_drives_scientific_reasoning
then: inference to best explanation typically applied
derivation_rules.why: Beyond formal logic. 'What best explains?' is daily scientific reasoning. Foundation of method. Probability frameworks formalise.

derivation_rules.name: structural_realism_survives_theory_change
if: theories change but mathematical structure preserved
derivation_rules.why: Fresnel's wave equations preserved through theory changes. Structures persist; entities replaced. Contemporary realist response to PMI.

derivation_rules.name: values_shape_inductive_risk
then: values determine balance of false positives + negatives
derivation_rules.why: Douglas: false positives vs false negatives have asymmetric costs. Cancer vs drug approval. Values inevitable, even in 'pure' science.

derivation_rules.name: replicability_crisis_drives_reform
then: methods must reform (pre-registration, transparency, larger N)
derivation_rules.why: Psychology 2010s, biology + medicine following. Open science movement. Affects how AI evaluations done. Modern.
